_comments: Quoting and bundle allocation already read ProductPrice rows. This column was seeded as a
list price and shown on the product hero, which created a second source of truth.
NOT dropped: Open App no-break policy forbids dropping columns within a published major.
IncludeInGeneratedForm = 0 is what keeps it off new generated forms.
AutoUpdateDescription = 0 so CodeGen does not restore the old column comment.

fields.Description: DEPRECATED — do not use as a list price or quote. What someone pays is MJ_BizApps_Orders: Product Prices (Name, Amount, Applicability). Bundle SSP allocation already reads those rows. Column retained so historical SPs and existing data still validate; do not populate it for new products.
